page_title: AST 2-0 TOT | Aston Villa v Tottenham Hotspur 16/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Marco Asensio (Aston Villa) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Antonin Kinsky easily deals with the threat.
90+5' Aston Villa take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+5' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
90+4' Half-chance! Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) plays a pass into the box, but Emiliano Martinez reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90+2' Aston Villa take a short corner kick.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Unai Emery has decided to make a change. Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) replaces John McGinn.
88' The substitution has been made. Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) has replaced Amadou Onana.
87' Ange Postecoglou is forced to make a change. Mikey Moore (Tottenham) is unable to continue due to injury, Brennan Johnson comes on.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Richarlison (Tottenham) comes onto the pitch so that Wilson Odobert can be given a rest.
86' Unai Emery has decided to substitute Ollie Watkins and he is replaced by Donyell Malen (Aston Villa).
85' Marco Asensio (Aston Villa) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Antonin Kinsky intercepts the ball.
83' 7:1 – the corner kicks stats.
81' A spell of possession for Aston Villa in an attempt to control the game.
78' 16:3 – the total goal attempt statistics.
75' John McGinn (Aston Villa) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.
75' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but John McGinn (Aston Villa) takes it short.
74' Ange Postecoglou has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) replacing Heung-Min Son.
74' Substitution. Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) in, Sergio Reguilon out.
73' 2 - 0 Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) strikes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it goes straight inside the left post!
70' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
69' That was close. John McGinn (Aston Villa) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
69' John McGinn (Aston Villa) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
67' Total attempts – 11:3.
64' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) commits a rough challenge and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul.
62' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.

61' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Antonin Kinsky guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
59' 1 - 0 GOAL - 1:0! The corner comes over and Ollie Watkins flicks on with his head to Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa), who makes no mistake and fires the ball into the back of the net.
59' Corner kick. Aston Villa will have an opportunity.
59' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
58' Marco Asensio (Aston Villa) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
54' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but Emiliano Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.
54' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Antonin Kinsky, who smothers the ball.
53' Here is a change. Pape Matar Sarr is going off and Ange Postecoglou gives the last tactical orders to Yves Bissouma (Tottenham).
48' Marco Asensio (Aston Villa) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) is flagged for offside.
45' Marco Asensio (Aston Villa) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
43' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
42' Aston Villa are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.

38' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is aimed towards the middle of the net, but Antonin Kinsky pulls off a comfortable save to thwart him.
36' Marco Asensio (Aston Villa) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
33' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Archie Gray (Tottenham) was quite harsh and Peter Bankes didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
32' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 6:2.
29' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
27' A cross into the box picks out Marco Asensio (Aston Villa), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot well wide of the left post.
25' Dangerous play by Mathys Tel (Tottenham). Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
21' Archie Gray (Tottenham) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
19' A quickly taken corner by Aston Villa.

19' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the right side of the goal, but Antonin Kinsky is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
18' Peter Bankes blows for a foul after Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
16' Djed Spence (Tottenham) makes a rough challenge and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just over the bar.
14' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Marco Asensio (Aston Villa), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
14' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Peter Bankes saw the whole situation.
13' Emiliano Martinez leaps to intercept the corner kick from Heung-Min Son (Tottenham).
12' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
10' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
7' A rebound falls to John McGinn (Aston Villa) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just over the bar.
6' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
5' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
3' Aston Villa hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
